plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole glaive including the blade, the back frame, the cloak, limbs and boots within frame. idle_h3_v1.action: A grim, watchful idle that loops. The reaver breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the glaive dips slightly and lifts so the little lanterns swing, the hooded head turns to scan and the cloak stirs, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Stride in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with long heavy steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel, the glaive carried level toward screen right with the lanterns swinging and the cloak streaming back. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE glaive thrust toward screen right. The reaver draws the glaive back low as the knees bend and the torso coils, then steps into a long lunge and drives the blade straight out to full reach at screen right, draws back and settles into the original stance. One thrust only; no slash trails or sparks.

hit_h3_v1.action: The reaver starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The hooded head and shoulders hunch and twist back and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the glaive, then the reaver straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low and hold the glaive shaft horizontally in front of the body with both hands as a barrier, the blade toward screen right, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. The reaver raises the glaive upright with the blade pointing straight up and holds it high as a standard, the lanterns swinging, holds the pose briefly, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. The reaver doubles over and sinks onto both knees, leaning on the glaive, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward and lies flat on the ground, finishing motionless with the hood at screen right, the cloak spread over the body and the glaive lying on the ground beside it. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
